item.title: Introducing Lumen 2, a smaller open model with a longer context window
item.description:
Lumen 2 is an open-weights language model that reads prompts of up to 1 million tokens & runs on a single GPU.

We are releasing it under the Apache 2.0 licence.

item.title: How we evaluate long-context models
item.description: A look at the benchmarks we use to test whether models find facts buried in long prompts.
